component.name: Vingilot
component.summary: Fast, distraction-free GTK4 and Libadwaita web browser with native Wayland acceleration

description.p: Vingilot is a privacy-first, native Linux web browser built from the ground up in Rust with GTK4, Libadwaita, and WebKitGTK 6.0. Engineered specifically for modern Wayland desktops and Linux mobile environments, Vingilot delivers fluid touch gestures, adaptive responsive layouts, and zero-compromise hardware-accelerated rendering.
With built-in tracking protection and local cryptographic isolation, your browsing remains private, fast, and sandboxed without external cloud dependencies.

ul.li: Hardware-Accelerated Wayland Engine: Native WebKitGTK 6.0 integration with GPU rendering and low battery consumption
Círdan Password Manager: Offline encrypted credentials vault protected by Argon2id and AES-256-GCM
Built-in Content Shield: Ad and tracker blocker supporting AdGuard and EasyList rule compilations
Standalone Download Daemon: Resilient multi-part file downloader with desktop notifications and tray controls
True Black & Custom Themes: OLED-black styling, Nord accents, and customizable backdrop blur
Dual AI Assistant: Native in-browser side panel supporting Google Gemini and OpenAI-compatible providers

description.p: Version 0.1.6 release featuring shared crate consolidation, standalone download daemon integration, security hardening, and packaging parity.

Version 0.1.5 release featuring native Google Gemini AI API support distributed via Google AI Studio (v1beta generateContent and model discovery), Anthropic Claude API support, interactive AI provider preset selector in Preferences, and CLI AI assistant provider options.

Version 0.1.4 release featuring GTK4 theme parser syntax fixes, translucent glassmorphic menu popovers with backdrop blur, redesigned 4-mode top selector circles (Auto Split, Light, Dark Neutral, True Black OLED), clean CLI parameter validation, and package updates.

Version 0.1.3 featuring persistent CSS theme providers, Nord Frost and dark appearance persistence, multi-engine prefix shortcuts (/e for Ecosia), interactive Find in Page popover, global keyboard accelerators, incognito sidebar toggle, and live preferences integration.

Beta release featuring native Libadwaita Start Page with dynamic search bar, customizable GNOME accent palette, recent cards with page previews, Opera-style drag-and-drop bookmark management, resizable settings pane, address bar bookmarking star, and distraction-free reading mode.

Alpha release featuring native Libadwaita Start Page with dynamic search bar, recently viewed cards with page previews, Opera-style drag-and-drop bookmark management, collapsible vertical tab sidebar, and unified chrome styling.
